secrets.name: Between the Pages
secrets.text: Where the leaves part at the edge there is room to crawl in. Someone has made a bed of loose pages here, and pressed a flower, and read by candlelight with the whole book over their head.

meta.label: One Book
meta.blurb: There is one book in this hall, lying open. You could walk across it. People do; there are footprints in the margins.
